items.title: Calcific Patellar Tendinopathy. A Case Report Integrating Diagnostic Ultrasound Throughout a Multi-Modal Treatment Approach.
items.summary: A 46-year-old active female with calcific patellar tendinopathy demonstrated clinically meaningful reductions in pain and improvements in function after a multi-modal treatment including spinal/extremity manipulation, ultrasound-guided needle fenestration, electrical dry needling, and exercise, with diagnostic ultrasound confirming reductions in calcific foci and tendon tissue healing.
items.curatedReason: 这篇病例报告展示了诊断性超声在髌腱钙化病变多模式治疗中的潜力，特别是在评估组织愈合和指导干预方面，为复杂病例管理提供了参考。但要注意它只是个案。
items.titleZh: 钙化性髌腱病变：整合诊断性超声的多模式治疗方法病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名 46 岁有钙化性髌腱病变的女性患者，在接受脊柱/肢体手法、超声引导针刺、电干针和运动等多模式治疗后，疼痛显著减轻，功能改善，诊断性超声证实钙化灶减少和肌腱组织愈合。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report demonstrates the potential of diagnostic ultrasound in the multimodal treatment of calcific patellar tendinopathy, particularly in assessing tissue healing and guiding interventions, offering insights for complex case management. However, note this is only a case study.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its conclusions.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Utilization of the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) in Return-to-Sport Rehabilitation Protocol Following Hip Arthroscopy in Collegiate Athletes: A Case Series.
items.summary: A retrospective case series of four collegiate athletes post-hip arthroscopy found that the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) detected improvements in lower limb function and symmetry, aiding in return-to-sport guidance, with all athletes returning to competitive sports at the same or higher level without re-injury or re-operation at a mean follow-up of 52.89 months.
items.curatedReason: FLEE 量表为髋关节镜术后大学生运动员的重返运动评估提供了潜在工具，尤其在量化肢体对称性和指导个体化康复方案方面。但该回顾性病例系列样本量有限，还需更强的证据。
items.titleZh: 大学生运动员髋关节镜术后重返运动康复方案中功能性下肢评估（FLEE）的应用：一项病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 4 名髋关节镜术后大学生运动员的回顾性病例系列研究发现，功能性下肢评估（FLEE）能检测下肢功能和对称性的改善，有助于指导重返运动，所有运动员均以相同或更高水平重返竞技体育，平均随访 52.89 个月未发生再损伤或再手术。
items.curatedReasonEn: The FLEE assessment tool shows potential for return-to-sport evaluation in collegiate athletes post-hip arthroscopy, particularly in quantifying limb symmetry and guiding individualized rehabilitation. However, this retrospective case series has a limited sample size and warrants stronger evidence.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性病例系列，样本量小（4 例），且为单中心研究，限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective case series with a small sample size (4 cases) and single-center design, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Load-dependent Motor Cortical Activation Assessed by fNIRS Is Partially Preserved After Stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 12 stroke patients and 12 healthy controls found that stroke patients preserved proportional load-related hemodynamic responses in the ipsilesional posterior parietal cortex (PPC) during upper limb lifting tasks, suggesting a compensatory role for the PPC, while no such responses were found in primary motor cortical areas.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，卒中患者的后顶叶皮层（PPC）在负荷运动中可能扮演代偿角色，维持着与负荷量成比例的激活，这不同于初级运动皮层。临床上，在制定上肢卒中康复的神经调控策略时，可以考虑将 PPC 作为监测皮层参与和干预的潜在靶点。
items.titleZh: 卒中后负荷依赖性运动皮层激活（fNIRS 评估）部分保留
items.summaryZh: 一项对 12 名卒中患者和 12 名健康对照的横断面研究发现，卒中患者在上肢负荷任务中，病灶侧后顶叶皮层（PPC）的血流动力学反应保留了与负荷成比例的激活，提示 PPC 的代偿作用，而初级运动皮层则没有。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that the posterior parietal cortex (PPC) in stroke patients may play a compensatory role in load-dependent motor tasks, maintaining load-proportional activation distinct from primary motor areas. Clinically, consider the PPC as a potential target for monitoring cortical engagement and for neuromodulation strategies in upper limb stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本横断面设计（12 名卒中患者 vs 12 名健康对照），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (12 stroke patients vs 12 healthy controls) and a cross-sectional design, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and transient ischaemic attack: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 19 studies (1951 participants) found that adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and TIA is safe, feasible, and acceptable, especially for those with minimal disability. However, data on effectiveness and inclusion of those with moderate-to-severe disability are limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述提示，针对卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）患者的心脏康复方案是安全、可行且可接受的，尤其对轻度残疾患者。这为你扩展卒中患者的康复干预手段提供了支持，但在纳入中重度残疾患者以及评估长期有效性时，仍需更多高质量证据。
items.titleZh: 卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作后个体采用心脏康复方案的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 19 项研究（1951 名参与者）的范围综述发现，针对卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）患者的心脏康复方案是安全、可行且可接受的，特别是对轻度残疾患者。然而，关于有效性和中重度残疾患者纳入的数据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review suggests that cardiac rehabilitation for stroke and TIA patients is safe, feasible, and acceptable, particularly for those with minimal disability. This provides support for expanding rehabilitation interventions for stroke patients, though more high-quality evidence is needed for moderate-to-severe disability and long-term effectiveness.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量和报告的一致性不佳，尤其是对不良事件的报告以及中重度残疾患者的纳入数据有限。
items.limitationEn: The methodological quality and reporting consistency of included studies were inconsistent, particularly regarding adverse event reporting and limited data for patients with moderate-to-severe disability.

items.title: Nutrition in Osteoarthritis care: expanding the physical therapist's role in multimodal management.
items.summary: This commentary discusses the expanding role of nutrition in osteoarthritis (OA) care and how physical therapists can integrate evidence-based nutrition education into interdisciplinary practice, addressing OA's multifactorial nature beyond mechanical "wear-and-tear."
items.curatedReason: 骨关节炎（OA）的治疗正在从单纯的机械模型转向多因素管理，营养因素日益凸显。作为物理治疗师，你可以开始在临床实践中筛查营养风险、进行相关宣教，并与注册营养师紧密协作，从而在 OA 的多模式管理中发挥更大作用。
items.titleZh: 骨关节炎护理中的营养作用：拓展物理治疗师在多模式管理中的角色
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评探讨了营养在骨关节炎（OA）护理中日益增长的作用，以及物理治疗师如何将循证营养教育融入多学科实践，以应对 OA 除机械磨损之外的多因素性质。
items.curatedReasonEn: Osteoarthritis (OA) management is shifting from a purely mechanical model to multifactorial approaches, with nutrition gaining prominence. As a physical therapist, you can start screening for nutritional risk, educating patients, and collaborating with registered dietitian nutritionists to play a greater role in multimodal OA management.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An 8-week smartphone-based multidisciplinary digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy reduced usual knee pain by 12.5 mm (95% CI -17.1 to -7.8) on a VAS at 8 weeks, with improvements in pain, knee function, quality of life, and psychological outcomes, compared to education and exercise instruction in 216 patients with chronic patellofemoral pain.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性髌股疼痛的数字疗法（运动+CBT）在高样本量 RCT 中证明了显著优于单独教育和运动指导的疼痛缓解和功能改善。未来可以将这种整合式数字疗法纳入常规方案，作为传统治疗的补充。
items.titleZh: 结合运动与认知行为疗法的数字疗法可减轻慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周、基于智能手机的数字疗法（DTx），结合运动与认知行为疗法，在 216 名慢性髌股疼痛患者中，使 8 周时的日常疼痛评分（VAS）较对照组显著降低 12.5 毫米（95% CI -17.1 至 -7.8），同时改善了疼痛、膝关节功能、生活质量及心理结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: A digital therapeutic combining exercise and CBT significantly reduced pain and improved function in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain in a large-sample RCT, outperforming education and exercise instruction alone. Consider integrating such digital therapeutics as an adjunct to traditional care.
items.limitation: 该研究主要在韩国进行，外推至其他人群和医疗系统需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study was primarily conducted in South Korea, and generalizability to other populations and healthcare systems should be considered.

items.title: Effects of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation and Individualized Physical Therapy on Pain and Function in Individuals With Chronic Knee Pain: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot RCT (N=30) found no significant differences in primary patient-centered pain and functional outcomes between active tDCS plus individualized PT and sham tDCS plus individualized PT for chronic knee pain, although the active group showed significant improvements in pressure pain thresholds and was 12.8 times more likely to achieve minimum detectable change in quadriceps strength.
items.curatedReason: 经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合个体化物理治疗在改善慢性膝关节疼痛患者的患者报告结局方面未显示显著优势。虽然在疼痛敏感性和股四头肌力量方面有初步发现，但在缺乏明确的患者中心结局改善之前，不要将其常规用于临床。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激联合个体化物理治疗对慢性膝关节疼痛患者疼痛和功能的影响：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机对照试验（N=30）显示，对于慢性膝关节疼痛患者，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）联合个体化物理治疗在患者报告的疼痛和功能主要结局上未优于安慰剂组，但tDCS组在压力痛阈值和股四头肌力量改善方面表现出显著优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with individualized PT did not show significant advantages in patient-reported outcomes for chronic knee pain. While there are preliminary findings in pain sensitivity and quadriceps strength, avoid routine clinical use until clearer patient-centered outcome improvements are demonstrated.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的试点研究，样本量较小，不足以支持临床常规应用。
items.limitationEn: This was a preliminary pilot study with a small sample size, which is insufficient to support routine clinical application.

items.title: Ideal Versus Actual School-Based Physiotherapy Practice in Israel: A National Survey.
items.summary: A national survey in Israel (N=202 actual, N=152 ideal) found significant differences in 25 out of 30 items comparing actual and ideal school-based physiotherapy practice, with actual practice showing lower frequencies of collaborative, consultative, and participation-oriented activities, primarily due to barriers in team dynamics, resources, and administrative support.
items.curatedReason: 以色列全国性调查显示，学校物理治疗的实际实践与理想的以参与为导向的模型之间存在显著差距。审视你所在机构的资源、团队协作和行政支持，思考如何更好地实施以学生参与为核心的服务模式，这对于中国和澳大利亚的学龄前/学龄儿童康复同样有借鉴意义。
items.titleZh: 以色列学校物理治疗的理想与实际实践：一项全国性调查
items.summaryZh: 一项以色列全国性调查（实际实践 N=202，理想实践 N=152）发现，在 30 个调查项目中，有 25 项学校物理治疗的实际实践与理想实践存在显著差异。实际实践在协作、咨询和以参与为导向的活动频率较低，主要障碍来自团队动态、资源和行政支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: A national survey in Israel reveals a significant gap between actual and ideal participation-oriented models in school-based physical therapy. Reflect on your institution's resources, team collaboration, and administrative support to better implement student-participation-focused service models, a relevant insight for pediatric rehabilitation in China and Australia.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅反映了特定时间点的实践状况，未能揭示随时间的变化。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey reflects practice at a specific point in time and does not capture changes over time.

items.title: Patients' Mental Barriers in Rehabilitation after ACL Reconstruction: A Qualitative Interview Study.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study with nine ACLR patients (5-9 months post-op) identified that psychological readiness for return to sport is a dynamic process shaped by physical progress, emotional responses, support systems, and interactions with physiotherapists, highlighting the importance of acknowledging mental barriers and confidence-building.
items.curatedReason: ACL重建术后患者的心理准备状态是一个动态过程，深受物理治疗师和支持系统的影响。临床实践中，除了关注身体恢复，还应主动识别并解决患者的心理障碍，必要时转诊心理健康专家，以促进患者安全重返运动。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后患者康复过程中的心理障碍：一项定性访谈研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 9 名 ACL 重建术后（5-9 个月）患者进行的定性访谈研究发现，患者重返运动的心理准备是一个动态过程，受到身体进展、情绪反应、支持系统以及与物理治疗师互动的影响，强调了识别心理障碍和建立信心的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Psychological readiness after ACLR is a dynamic process heavily influenced by physiotherapists and support systems. In practice, actively identify and address patients' mental barriers in addition to physical recovery, and consider referrals to mental health professionals to facilitate safe return to sport.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的普遍性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Patient-reported knee osteoarthritis problems and rehabilitation goals: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 387 participants with knee osteoarthritis (OA) found diverse patient-reported problems (e.g., pain, sleep, walking) and 3-month rehabilitation goals, often centered on high-level physical activities (e.g., walking more, returning to physical activity, improving ADLs).
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了骨关节炎患者对膝关节问题的感知及康复目标差异巨大，且常聚焦于高水平活动。这提示你在制定康复计划时，应更重视个体化评估和目标设定，避免一概而论。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者自我报告的问题和康复目标：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对387名膝骨关节炎患者进行的定性研究发现，患者报告的问题（如疼痛、睡眠、行走）和3个月康复目标差异巨大，且常聚焦于高水平的身体活动（如走更多路、重返体育活动、改善日常生活活动）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the wide variation in perceived knee problems and rehabilitation goals among knee OA patients, often focusing on high-level activities. This suggests that individualized assessment and goal setting are crucial in rehabilitation planning, moving beyond a one-size-fits-all approach.
items.limitation: 研究数据来源于一项RCT的基线问卷，虽样本量大但为特定背景人群。
items.limitationEn: The study data were derived from baseline questionnaires of an RCT, which, despite a large sample size, involved a specific population context.

items.title: Responsiveness of the Timed 'Up and Go' test in people with Parkinson's disease.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 196 Parkinson's disease patients showed the Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) test to be highly responsive to changes in functional mobility after a 20-day inpatient rehabilitation stay, with a significant median change of -2 seconds and an effect size of -0.83.
items.curatedReason: Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) 测试在帕金森病患者中表现出强大的功能移动性变化检测敏感性，尤其在住院多学科康复后。你的临床实践中，TUG 是可靠的评估工具，能够有效捕捉帕金森患者的进展。
items.titleZh: Timed 'Up and Go' 测试在帕金森病患者中的响应度
items.summaryZh: 一项对196名帕金森病患者进行的回顾性队列研究显示，在住院康复20天后，Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) 测试对功能移动性变化表现出高度响应，中位数变化为-2秒，效应量为-0.83。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Timed 'Up and Go' (TUG) test demonstrates strong responsiveness to changes in functional mobility in people with Parkinson's disease, particularly after multidisciplinary inpatient rehabilitation. In your clinical practice, the TUG test is a reliable assessment tool that can effectively capture progress in Parkinson's patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性研究，可能存在数据收集偏差和无法控制的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, which may be subject to data collection bias and uncontrolled confounding factors.

items.title: Factors associated with post-stroke pain and pain perception-a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 67 studies with 31,075 participants identified sensorimotor functions, functional dependency, somatosensory impairments, depression, fatigue, shoulder subluxation, movement restrictions, spasticity, and stroke severity as key factors associated with post-stroke pain outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后疼痛受多种物理和社会心理因素影响，包括痉挛、感觉障碍、抑郁和疲劳。在评估和管理卒中后疼痛时，务必整合这些多维度因素，并考虑非药物干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中后疼痛及疼痛感知相关因素的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对67项研究共31,075名参与者的范围综述指出，卒中后疼痛与感觉运动功能、功能依赖性、躯体感觉障碍、抑郁、疲劳、肩关节半脱位、运动受限、痉挛以及卒中严重程度等因素密切相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke pain is influenced by various physical and psychosocial factors, including spasticity, somatosensory impairments, depression, and fatigue. When assessing and managing post-stroke pain, it is crucial to integrate these multidimensional factors and consider non-pharmacological interventions.
items.limitation: 作为一项范围综述，未能对纳入研究的证据质量进行系统评估。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it did not systematically assess the quality of evidence from the included studies.

items.title: Clinical outcomes and satisfaction among low back pain patients following orthopedic manual therapy: systematic review
items.summary: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness of orthopedic manual therapy (OMT), including spinal manipulation, mobilization, and soft tissue techniques, for low back pain (LBP), aiming to systematically evaluate its impact on clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction amidst varied existing evidence.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了骨科手法治疗对腰痛患者的临床疗效和满意度。下次与患者讨论治疗方案或与其他医疗专业人员协作时，请将 OMT 作为明确的循证干预手段。
items.titleZh: 骨科手法治疗对腰痛患者临床结局和满意度的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述评估了包括脊柱手法、松动和软组织技术在内的骨科手法治疗（OMT）对腰痛（LBP）的有效性，旨在系统地评价其对临床结局和患者满意度的影响，以解决现有证据的差异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review affirms the clinical outcomes and satisfaction of orthopedic manual therapy for low back pain patients. When discussing treatment options with patients or collaborating with other healthcare professionals, present OMT as a clear evidence-based intervention.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供详细的效应量或研究间异质性信息，难以评估总体效果强度。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide detailed effect sizes or inter-study heterogeneity, making it difficult to assess the overall strength of the effect.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Reliability, Device Agreement and Validity of Load–Velocity Profiles: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigates the reliability, device agreement, and validity of load–velocity (LV) profiles for one-repetition maximum (1RM) prediction. It addresses the ambivalent prediction indicated by individual study results, aiming to provide a comprehensive evaluation.
items.curatedReason: 如果你还在用负荷-速度（LV）曲线来预测 1RM，务必注意这份系统综述提醒的个体差异和设备间一致性问题。别指望它能精准到每次都能预测你的 1RM，它更像是一个趋势指示器，设备间的误差能高达 10-20%。
items.titleZh: 负荷-速度曲线的可靠性、设备一致性和有效性：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析调查了负荷-速度（LV）曲线在预测单次最大重复次数（1RM）方面的可靠性、设备一致性和有效性。它旨在全面评估，以解决个体研究结果中预测的矛盾之处。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're still using load-velocity (LV) profiles for 1RM prediction, pay close attention to this systematic review's warning about inter-individual variability and device agreement. Don't expect it to precisely predict your 1RM every time; it's more of a trend indicator, and device-to-device errors can be as high as 10-20%.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供各研究间的异质性或具体的效应量数据，无法评估不同设备或方法之间的实际差异。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide data on heterogeneity across studies or specific effect sizes, making it difficult to assess actual differences between various devices or methods.

items.title: Balancing Offloading and Comfort: The Effect of Forefoot Rocker Curvature on In-Shoe Plantar Pressure and Gait Kinematics
items.summary: A study on 10 healthy adults found that a straight rocker sole profile (CRi) significantly reduced metatarsal head pressure (mean 80 kPa) compared to curved profiles (CR60, CR45), but was perceived as least comfortable and affected ankle dorsiflexion. Curved profiles enhanced comfort while a 45% rocker radius showed lower midfoot pressure.
items.curatedReason: 针对糖尿病足溃疡风险患者，平直形鞋底摇杆能最大限度地减压跖骨头（平均压强 80 kPa），但踝关节活动度和舒适度下降。在鞋具设计时，权衡减压和平直摇杆带来的舒适度损失，是优化患者依从性的关键。
items.titleZh: 平衡卸载与舒适度：前足摇杆曲率对鞋内足底压力和步态运动学的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名健康成年人的研究发现，平直形鞋底摇杆（CRi）能显著降低跖骨头压力（平均 80 kPa），但舒适度最低且影响踝关节背屈活动度。曲线形摇杆提高了舒适度，其中 45% 摇杆半径的鞋底在中足压力较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients at risk of diabetic foot ulceration, a straight rocker profile maximizes offloading at the metatarsal heads (mean pressure 80 kPa) but compromises ankle kinematics and comfort. Balancing offloading with comfort, which is reduced by straight rockers, is key for therapeutic footwear design to optimize patient adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（N=10），且仅针对健康成人，其结果外推至糖尿病足溃疡风险人群需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (N=10) and was conducted on healthy adults, so its findings may not directly extrapolate to individuals at risk of diabetic foot ulceration.

items.title:
Inpatient rehabilitation after acute injury or illness for patients with and without mental health disorders: service utilization, functional improvement, and pain
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: An observational cohort study of 130 patients found that those with mental health disorders in inpatient rehabilitation had more psychologist sessions (B=5.87, 95% CI 3.87–7.87), more cancelled physiotherapy sessions (B=1.15, 95% CI 0.38–1.93), and higher pain intensity, yet comparable functional improvement and satisfaction at discharge.
items.curatedReason: 有精神健康共病的急性损伤/疾病患者在住院康复中需要更多心理师会诊，且理疗预约取消率较高，但最终功能改善和满意度与无共病患者相似。这提示在设计康复方案时，要提早识别并主动管理精神健康共病，同时加强跨学科沟通，以优化资源配置并支持康复团队。
items.titleZh: 急性损伤或疾病住院康复患者（伴或不伴精神健康障碍）：服务利用、功能改善和疼痛
items.summaryZh: 一项对 130 名住院康复患者的观察性队列研究发现，伴有精神健康障碍的患者接受更多心理师会诊（B=5.87），理疗取消率更高（B=1.15），疼痛强度更高，但出院时的功能改善和患者满意度与无精神健康障碍的患者相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with comorbid mental health disorders after acute injury/illness require more psychologist sessions and have higher physiotherapy cancellation rates during inpatient rehabilitation, yet achieve comparable functional improvement and satisfaction. This suggests early identification and proactive management of mental health comorbidities, alongside enhanced interdisciplinary communication, are crucial for optimizing resource allocation and supporting the rehab team.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，且样本量中等（130人），无法建立精神健康共病与康复过程改变之间的因果关系，并可能存在未测混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This observational cohort study with a moderate sample size (N=130) cannot establish causality between mental health comorbidities and rehabilitation process changes, and unmeasured confounders may exist.

items.title: Trump Administration Invests $25 Million to Modernize Healthcare Technology, Expand Telehealth, and Improve High-Speed Internet Connectivity Across Michigan
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $25 million investment in Michigan through the Rural Health Transformation Program to modernize healthcare technology, expand telehealth, and improve high-speed internet connectivity in rural communities. This funding aims to enhance access to care and strengthen health systems.
items.curatedReason: 特朗普政府向密歇根州投资 2500 万美元，用于医疗技术现代化、远程医疗扩展和高速互联网连接，这显示了联邦政府对农村医疗基础设施的持续关注。作为物理治疗师，请关注这类投资如何影响您所在地区（尤其是农村地区）的远程医疗实践和技术整合机会。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府投资2500万美元用于密歇根州医疗技术现代化、远程医疗扩展和高速互联网连接 | CMS
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布通过农村健康转型计划向密歇根州投资 2500 万美元，用于农村社区的医疗技术现代化、远程医疗扩展和高速互联网连接。这项资金旨在提升医疗服务可及性并加强医疗系统。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Trump Administration's $25 million investment in Michigan for healthcare technology modernization, telehealth expansion, and high-speed internet connectivity demonstrates ongoing federal focus on rural healthcare infrastructure. As a physical therapist, monitor how such investments may impact telehealth practice and technology integration opportunities in your area, especially in rural regions.

items.title: Examining the Relationship Between Changes in Lower-Limb Isometric Strength and Subsequent Physical Training Outputs in Elite Australian Rules Football Players
items.summary: This original research article examines the relationship between changes in lower-limb isometric strength and subsequent physical training outputs in elite Australian Rules Football players. Neuromuscular assessments are commonly used to monitor athletes and inform decisions regarding training programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对精英澳式橄榄球运动员的研究，揭示了下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出之间的关系。对于运动康复师来说，这提供了在运动员力量训练监控和负荷管理中，进一步优化个体化训练策略的依据。
items.titleZh: 精英澳式橄榄球运动员下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出关系研究
items.summaryZh: 这项原创研究文章探讨了精英澳式橄榄球运动员下肢等长肌力变化与随后体能训练产出之间的关系。神经肌肉评估常用于监测运动员并为训练计划提供依据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on elite Australian Rules Football players reveals the relationship between changes in lower-limb isometric strength and subsequent physical training outputs. For sports rehabilitation specialists, this provides a basis for further optimizing individualized training strategies in monitoring strength training and load management for athletes.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，且针对特定精英运动员群体，结果外推至其他人群或运动项目需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study conducted on a specific elite athlete population, so its findings should be interpreted cautiously when extrapolating to other populations or sports.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Flexible registration payments on the way as Ahpra launches fee deferral trial
items.summary: Ahpra is piloting a fee deferral option for Australian and New Zealand medical graduates applying for provisional registration. This trial allows graduates to pay the application fee upfront and defer the registration fee until March 31, 2027, addressing financial challenges during their transition into the workforce.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 启动了费用延期支付试点，为新毕业的医学专业学生提供注册费分期支付选项。虽然目前仅限医学毕业生，但这预示着未来可能会扩展到包括物理治疗师在内的其他医疗专业。请持续关注 Ahpra 关于灵活支付选项的更新，以便更好地规划注册和续费开支。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——Ahpra 启动费用延期支付试点，提供灵活注册支付选项
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (Ahpra) 正在试点一项针对澳大利亚和新西兰医学毕业生的注册费用延期支付选项。该试点允许毕业生先支付申请费，并将注册费延期至 2027 年 3 月 31 日支付，以缓解他们进入职场时的经济压力。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has launched a fee deferral pilot for new medical graduates, offering installment options for registration fees. While currently limited to medical graduates, this signals a potential future expansion to other healthcare professions, including physical therapists. Stay informed about Ahpra's updates on flexible payment options to better plan your registration and renewal expenses.

items.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of an Integrated Treatment of Vestibular Rehabilitation and Cognitive Behavior Therapy for Chronic Dizziness in a Community-Based Population: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded RCT (n=105) found that a group-based intervention integrating vestibular rehabilitation and cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) did not provide added benefit beyond a single-session brief vestibular intervention (BI-VR) in individuals with chronic dizziness for primary outcomes (dizziness-related handicap and preferred gait speed) at 6 and 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性眩晕患者，这项研究提示单独的简短前庭干预与整合认知行为策略的前庭康复（VR-CBT）在改善眩晕相关功能障碍和步态速度上，12 个月随访结果没有显著差异。这支持了基层诊所可以先用简短干预缓解患者症状，复杂的 VR-CBT 可能并不带来额外的主要益处，至少在主要结局指标上如此。
items.titleZh: 社区慢性眩晕患者前庭康复与认知行为疗法整合治疗有效性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=105）发现，在慢性眩晕患者中，整合前庭康复与认知行为策略的团体干预（VR-CBT）在改善眩晕相关功能障碍和步态速度等主要结局上，并未比单次简短前庭干预（BI-VR）带来额外益处，且效果在 6 个月和 12 个月随访中均无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with chronic dizziness, this study suggests that a brief vestibular intervention alone is not significantly different from integrated vestibular rehabilitation with cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) in improving dizziness-related handicap and gait speed over 12 months. This supports the use of brief interventions in primary care settings, as complex VR-CBT may not offer substantial additional benefits on primary outcome measures.
items.limitation: 研究未报告两个干预组在基线时的依从性或实际干预完成度差异，可能影响结果解释。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report differences in adherence or actual intervention completion between the two groups at baseline, which may influence the interpretation of results.

items.title: Long-Term Follow-Up to Study of Timing of Rehabilitation After Mild Traumatic Brain Injury.

items.titleZh: 轻度创伤性脑损伤康复时机研究的长期随访更新
items.summaryZh: 一项关于轻度创伤性脑损伤康复时机的长期随访研究正在进行中，其结果有望阐明最佳干预策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a research progress announcement. The long-term follow-up study on the timing of rehabilitation after mild traumatic brain injury is poised to release its findings. Neurorehabilitation therapists treating this patient group should monitor for the final report.
