items.titleZh: 2026 年 9 月 9 日，做好准备！支付方变化为何能颠覆未准备好的账单实践
items.summaryZh: 支付方政策的变化可能显著打乱物理治疗诊所的账单实践，这强调了主动准备以减轻财务和运营挑战的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Frequent changes in payer policies can directly impact your clinic's revenue and operating model, so you need to proactively understand and adjust your billing and reimbursement strategies to address potential challenges.

items.title: Novel Telerehabilitation Interventions for Stress Urinary Incontinence : A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 13 RCTs found telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) to be a safe, feasible, and effective modality for stress urinary incontinence (SUI), showing significant subjective symptom reductions and improved quality of life, with comparable efficacy to conventional care.
items.curatedReason: 远程盆底肌训练对压力性尿失禁有效且安全，与面对面治疗效果相当。它提供了新的可及性，对扩展治疗覆盖面很有意义，特别是在地理和物流受限地区。
items.titleZh: 远程康复干预治疗压力性尿失禁：随机对照试验系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 13 项随机对照试验的系统综述发现，远程康复提供的盆底肌训练（PFMT）是治疗压力性尿失禁（SUI）安全、可行且有效的方式，可显著主观减少症状并改善生活质量，且疗效与传统护理相当。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training is effective and safe for stress urinary incontinence, with comparable efficacy to face-to-face care. It offers new accessibility, crucial for expanding treatment reach, especially in geographically or logistically challenged areas.
items.limitation: 研究间方法学和临床异质性显著，无法进行荟萃分析，结论主要基于叙述性综合。
items.limitationEn: Significant methodological and clinical heterogeneity between studies prevented meta-analysis, with conclusions based primarily on narrative synthesis.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Novel Telerehabilitation Interventions for Stress Urinary Incontinence : A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trials

items.title: Home-based digital exercise versus hospital physiotherapy for plantar fasciitis: a propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study with dual-perspective cost-utility evaluation.
items.summary: A propensity-score-matched retrospective cohort study in China (n=587) found that a 12-week home-based digital exercise program was non-inferior to hospital physiotherapy for 3-month first-step morning pain in plantar fasciitis (adjusted mean difference -0.63 points, 95% CI -0.92 to -0.35; p < 0.001) and was less costly from both payer and societal perspectives.
items.curatedReason: 居家数字化运动方案对足底筋膜炎患者在 3 个月时的首次晨痛方面不劣于医院物理治疗，且成本更低。考虑到中国三级医院的背景，这为优化资源配置、探索非传统交付模式提供了初步数据。
items.titleZh: 居家数字化运动与医院物理治疗对足底筋膜炎的疗效与成本：一项倾向得分匹配回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在中国进行的回顾性队列研究（n=587）发现，为期 12 周的居家数字化运动方案在治疗足底筋膜炎的 3 个月晨起首步疼痛方面不劣于医院物理治疗（调整后均值差 -0.63 分，95% CI -0.92 至 -0.35；p < 0.001），且从支付方和社会角度看成本更低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based digital exercise is non-inferior to hospital physiotherapy for first-step morning pain at 3 months in plantar fasciitis patients, and is less costly. This provides preliminary data for optimizing resource allocation and exploring non-traditional delivery models in the context of Chinese tertiary hospital care.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，尽管进行了倾向得分匹配，仍可能存在残余混杂和选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective cohort study, and despite propensity-score matching, residual confounding and selection bias are likely.

items.title: Living with stroke-related visual impairment: a qualitative exploration of lived experience, self-management, and support needs.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 16 community-dwelling adults in Scotland explored lived experiences, self-management strategies, and unmet support needs in stroke-related visual impairment (SRVI). SRVI caused multidimensional impacts; self-developed strategies were common, but unmet needs included delayed assessment, limited tailored information, and misaligned rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了卒中后视力障碍患者在日常生活、自我管理和支持需求方面的多维度影响和未满足的需求。这提示我们需要更早期的评估、更定制化的信息和持续的随访支持。
items.titleZh: 卒中相关视力障碍患者的生活体验、自我管理和支持需求的定性探索
items.summaryZh: 一项针对苏格兰 16 名社区卒中相关视力障碍成年人的定性研究发现，视力障碍对患者造成多维度影响，患者发展出多种自我管理策略，但仍存在评估延迟、信息不足和康复计划错位等未满足的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the multidimensional impact and unmet needs of stroke survivors with visual impairment in daily life, self-management, and support. It suggests the need for earlier assessment, tailored information, and sustained follow-up support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小且基于苏格兰社区人群，结果推广性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative exploratory study has a small sample size and is based on a Scottish community population, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Effects of Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training and physical therapy on gait quality in children with cerebral palsy: A severity-stratified analysis.
items.summary: A retrospective observational study of 52 children with cerebral palsy found that Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training combined with physical therapy improved spatiotemporal gait parameters and Gait Profile Score, with severity-dependent and joint-specific kinematic changes. Gross Motor Function Measure-88 total scores did not change significantly.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明 Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练结合物理治疗能改善脑瘫儿童的步态运动学，且效果因严重程度和关节而异。它提示我们在评估这类干预时，应使用精细的步态分析指标，而非仅依赖粗大运动功能总分。
items.titleZh: Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练与物理治疗对脑瘫儿童步态质量的影响：按严重程度分层分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 52 名脑瘫儿童的回顾性观察研究发现，Lokomat 机器人辅助步态训练结合物理治疗可改善时空步态参数和步态姿势评分，且运动学变化因严重程度和关节而异。粗大运动功能测量-88 总分未见显著变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that Lokomat-based robotic-assisted gait training combined with physical therapy can improve gait kinematics in children with cerebral palsy, with effects varying by severity and joint. It implies that detailed gait analysis metrics, rather than just gross motor function scores, should be used when evaluating such interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察性研究，非随机对照，存在混杂因素影响和结果偏差风险。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational study is not a randomized controlled trial, carrying risks of confounding factors and outcome bias.

items.title: Invisible Harms, Visible Benefits? Adverse Event Reporting in Physical Activity Interventions for Neurodevelopmental Disorders: A Meta-analysis and Critical Appraisal
items.summary: This meta-analysis and critical appraisal examines adverse event reporting in physical activity interventions for individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders, finding that current reporting practices are inadequate.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述揭示了针对神经发育障碍的体育活动干预在不良事件报告方面存在重大缺陷。这提醒你，在将体育活动纳入治疗方案时，必须加强对潜在风险的监测和标准化报告，以确保患者安全。
items.titleZh: 无形之害，可见之益？神经发育障碍体育活动干预中的不良事件报告：一项 Meta 分析与批判性评估
items.summaryZh: 这项 Meta 分析和批判性评估审视了神经发育障碍患者体育活动干预中的不良事件报告，发现目前的报告实践不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review reveals significant deficiencies in adverse event reporting for physical activity interventions in neurodevelopmental disorders. This highlights the critical need to improve monitoring and standardize reporting of potential risks when incorporating physical activity into treatment plans, ensuring patient safety.
items.limitation: 尽管是系统综述，但其结论受到原始研究中不良事件报告质量不足的限制，可能未能全面捕捉所有潜在风险。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review, its conclusions are limited by the inadequate quality of adverse event reporting in the original studies, which may not have captured all potential risks comprehensively.

items.title: Personalized FES-cycling patterns via optimal control: from musculoskeletal simulation to experimental validation
items.summary: This study introduces an optimal control framework for functional electrical stimulation (FES) cycling that produces personalized stimulation patterns directly transferable from simulation to experimental cycling, aiming to improve rehabilitation for neurological patients.
items.curatedReason: 本研究通过模拟和实验验证，提出了一种可个性化定制的 FES 循环模式，有望提高神经损伤患者的康复效果。它提示你关注 FES 技术在康复中的应用潜力，尤其是在优化患者个体化治疗方案方面。
items.titleZh: 通过最优控制实现个性化 FES 循环模式：从肌肉骨骼模拟到实验验证
items.summaryZh: 这项研究引入了一种功能性电刺激（FES）循环的最优控制框架，可直接将个性化刺激模式从模拟转移到实验循环，旨在改善神经系统患者的康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study proposes a personalized FES-cycling pattern, validated through simulation and experiment, with the potential to improve rehabilitation outcomes for patients with neurological injuries. It prompts you to consider the potential of FES technology in rehabilitation, particularly in optimizing individualized treatment plans.
items.limitation: 研究细节（如样本量和具体疾病类型）在摘要中未明确提及，可能影响结论的普适性。
items.limitationEn: Study details such as sample size and specific disease types are not explicitly mentioned in the abstract, which may affect the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: Integrated machine learning and clinical validation identify COL21A1 as a potential biomarker for sarcopenia
items.summary: This study used integrated machine learning and clinical validation to identify COL21A1 as a potential biomarker for sarcopenia.
items.curatedReason: COL21A1 可能成为肌少症的一个新生物标志物，这为我们早期诊断和干预提供了新思路。当然，这只是一个初步发现，其作为诊断工具的临床实用性仍需更多独立验证和大型研究。
items.titleZh: 机器学习与临床验证相结合识别 COL21A1 作为肌少症的潜在生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 这项研究结合机器学习和临床验证，确定了 COL21A1 作为肌少症的潜在生物标志物。
items.curatedReasonEn: COL21A1 shows promise as a potential new biomarker for sarcopenia, offering a fresh perspective on early diagnosis and intervention. Keep in mind, this is an initial finding; its clinical utility as a diagnostic tool still requires extensive independent validation and larger-scale studies.
items.limitation: 本研究的临床验证部分可能样本量有限，且生物标志物的发现到实际临床应用通常需要更广泛的多中心验证。
items.limitationEn: The clinical validation portion of this study may have a limited sample size, and the transition from biomarker discovery to practical clinical application typically requires more extensive multi-center validation.

items.title: Myofascial chain sequencing and performance adaptations in youth football players: an exploratory knowledge graph-supported analysis
items.summary: This exploratory study investigated the effects of myofascial chain-focused training on countermovement jump performance and dynamic balance in forty licensed adolescent football players.
items.curatedReason: 对青少年足球运动员来说，肌筋膜链训练或许能改善他们的跳跃表现和动态平衡。但由于是观察性研究，且样本量只有 40 人，现在就推荐将其作为常规训练项目还为时过早。
items.titleZh: 青少年足球运动员肌筋膜链序列与表现适应：一项知识图谱支持的探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 这项探索性研究调查了肌筋膜链聚焦训练对 40 名注册青少年足球运动员反向跳跃表现和动态平衡的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Myofascial chain training *might* improve jump performance and dynamic balance in adolescent football players. However, with only 40 participants in an observational study, it's premature to recommend this as a standard training component.
items.limitation: 这是一项针对特定青年足球运动员队列的探索性分析，样本量较小，且研究设计未明确说明为随机对照试验，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory analysis on a small, specific cohort of youth football players, and the study design is not explicitly stated as an RCT, so caution is needed when generalizing the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Tailoring Resistance Exercise for Knee Osteoarthritis: An Intervention Systematic Review With Dose-Response Meta-analysis of the Effects of Intensity and Volume.
items.summary: A dose-response meta-analysis of 20 RCTs (n=791) found that isotonic resistance training may reduce pain (MD, -3.52 at 6000 repetitions), improve function (MD, -16.66 at 2600 repetitions), and increase muscle strength (standardized MD, 0.12 at 1600 repetitions) in knee OA patients, with moderate intensity yielding the greatest estimated benefits.
items.curatedReason: 针对膝骨关节炎的阻力训练，这份剂量反应荟萃分析给出了具体参数：中等强度、6000 次重复总量的训练对疼痛缓解最有效；2600 次重复总量对功能改善最佳；1600 次对力量增益最大。这些数字为你优化门诊康复方案提供了细化证据。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎阻力训练的个体化方案：强度与训练量效应的剂量反应荟萃分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 20 项随机对照试验（791 名患者）的剂量反应荟萃分析显示，等张阻力训练可改善膝骨关节炎患者的疼痛（6000 次重复时平均差异为 -3.52）、功能（2600 次重复时平均差异为 -16.66）和肌肉力量（1600 次重复时标准化平均差异为 0.12）。中等强度训练与特定训练量可带来最大益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee OA resistance training, this dose-response meta-analysis offers specific parameters: moderate intensity with 6000 total repetitions is most effective for pain relief; 2600 total repetitions for functional improvement; and 1600 total repetitions for strength gains. These numbers provide detailed evidence to optimize your outpatient rehab protocols.
items.limitation: 证据确定性为低至极低，且中心化康复效果优于家庭康复，提示结果外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence is low to very low, and center-based programs showed more pronounced effects than home-based ones, suggesting caution in generalizing these findings.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: CMS Cracks Down on Massive $3.4 Billion Medical Equipment Supplier Fraud Scheme
items.summary: CMS announced a crackdown on a massive $3.4 billion medical equipment supplier fraud scheme, indicating increased scrutiny and enforcement actions against fraudulent activities within the healthcare system.
items.curatedReason: CMS 正在大力打击医疗设备供应商的欺诈行为，涉案金额高达 34 亿美元。作为康复领域专业人士，你应审查所有合作的医疗设备供应商资质，确保其合规性，规避潜在的法律风险与报销纠纷。
items.titleZh: CMS 打击 34 亿美元医疗设备供应商大规模欺诈计划
items.summaryZh: CMS 宣布将严厉打击一起涉案金额高达 34 亿美元的医疗设备供应商大规模欺诈计划，这表明医疗系统内部欺诈行为将面临更严格的审查和执法行动。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS is vigorously cracking down on medical equipment supplier fraud, with cases totaling $3.4 billion. As a rehabilitation professional, you should scrutinize the credentials of all medical equipment suppliers you collaborate with to ensure compliance and mitigate potential legal risks and reimbursement disputes.

items.title: The Efficacy of Exercise Therapy for Nonspecific Chronic Low Back Pain According to the FITT Principle: A Systematic Review With Meta-analyses.
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analyses found that exercise therapy following the FITT principle is effective in reducing disability in individuals with nonspecific chronic low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 运动疗法按照 FITT 原则，对非特异性慢性腰痛患者的残疾程度有确切的降低作用。这意味着你应在运动处方中积极运用频率、强度、时间、类型这些原则，这是目前最强的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 运动疗法对非特异性慢性腰痛疗效的 FITT 原则：系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与荟萃分析发现，遵循 FITT 原则的运动疗法能有效减轻非特异性慢性腰痛患者的残疾程度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise therapy following the FITT principle definitively reduces disability in individuals with nonspecific chronic low back pain. You should actively apply frequency, intensity, time, and type principles in your exercise prescriptions, as this is currently the strongest evidence available.
items.limitation: 该研究关注残疾结局，其他重要结局（如疼痛强度、生活质量）未被系统评估。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on disability outcomes, with other important outcomes (e.g., pain intensity, quality of life) not systematically assessed.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Proximal and Distal Bimanual Motor Skill Learning After Stroke: Impairments, Trajectories, and Clinical Contributors
items.summary: A randomized trial with 97 (sub)acute stroke patients found impairments in bimanual motor skill learning, particularly in distal upper limb segments, compared to healthy individuals.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机试验显示，卒中早期患者在双侧运动技能学习方面存在缺陷，且远端上肢受损更明显。这提示你在早期康复干预中应更侧重远端精细动作的双侧训练。
items.titleZh: 卒中后近端和远端双侧运动技能学习：损伤、轨迹和临床影响因素
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 97 名（亚）急性卒中患者的随机试验发现，卒中后双侧运动技能学习存在损伤，尤其在远端上肢节段更为明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized trial reveals that early post-stroke patients exhibit deficits in bimanual motor skill learning, with more pronounced impairment in the distal upper limb. This suggests a need to prioritize bimanual training for distal fine motor skills in early rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本主要为急性和亚急性期卒中患者，结果外推到慢性期需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily involved acute and subacute stroke patients, so generalizing the results to the chronic phase should be done with caution.

items.title: Addressing stroke family caregivers' mental health through person‑ and family‑centred rehabilitation.
items.summary: This review summarizes literature on stroke family caregivers' experiences and support needs, proposing person- and family-centered care (PFCC) as a potential approach to address caregiver mental health challenges.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提醒你关注卒中患者家属的心理健康需求，并指出以患者和家庭为中心（PFCC）的康复模式是弥补现有支持不足的关键策略。
items.titleZh: 通过以患者和家庭为中心的康复解决卒中家庭照护者的心理健康问题
items.summaryZh: 本综述总结了卒中家庭照护者经历和支持需求的文献，并提出以患者和家庭为中心的照护（PFCC）是解决照护者心理健康挑战的潜在方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights the mental health needs of stroke family caregivers and identifies person- and family-centered care (PFCC) as a key strategy to address gaps in current support.

items.title: Reliability, Validity, and Preliminary Diagnostic Exploration of a Novel Dynamic Balance Test Tool
items.summary: A novel X-Balance Test showed acceptable test–retest reliability (ICC 0.820–0.989) and moderate validity against the SEBT (r 0.495–0.770), but insufficient diagnostic accuracy for lower extremity injury risk (overall accuracy 61.76%, sensitivity 35.29%, specificity 88%).
items.curatedReason: 新工具的测量学表现不足以支撑临床应用——诊断准确性只有 61.76%，敏感性 35.29% 意味着大部分真有损伤风险的运动员会被漏掉。重测信度尚可，但以 SEBT 为参照的效度中等，现阶段没有理由用它替代现有的动态平衡评估。
items.titleZh: 新型动态平衡测试工具的测量学表现与损伤风险诊断探索
items.summaryZh: 新型 X-Balance Test 的重测信度尚可（ICC 0.820–0.989），与 SEBT 的效度中等（r 0.495–0.770），但对下肢损伤风险的诊断准确性不足（总体准确率 61.76%，敏感性 35.29%，特异性 88%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This tool isn't ready for clinical use—61.76% overall accuracy and 35.29% sensitivity means it misses most athletes who are actually at risk. Test-retest reliability is acceptable, but validity against the SEBT is only moderate. No reason to swap out your current dynamic balance assessment for this yet.
items.limitation: 诊断探索以 SEBT 为参照而非实际损伤结局，且为单一样本探索性分析，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: Diagnostic exploration used the SEBT as reference rather than actual injury outcomes, in a single exploratory sample, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Determining the optimal volume of reactive balance training after stroke: a pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A three-arm pilot randomized controlled trial (n=36) explored the feasibility of delivering 1, 3, or 6 sessions of reactive balance training over 2-3 weeks for people with sub-acute stroke, aiming to inform the design of a larger optimal volume trial.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性 RCT 提示，对于亚急性卒中患者，增加反应性平衡训练的干预量或可改善平衡功能。它为后续大样本研究设计提供了关键参考，但目前尚不足以改变临床方案。
items.titleZh: 确定卒中后反应性平衡训练的最佳剂量：一项试点随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三组试点随机对照试验（n=36）旨在探讨对亚急性卒中患者进行 1、3 或 6 次反应性平衡训练课程的可行性，为未来确定最佳训练剂量的更大规模试验提供设计依据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that increasing the volume of reactive balance training may improve balance function in sub-acute stroke patients. While it provides critical data for future larger trials, it is not yet sufficient to alter current clinical protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的试点研究，样本量较小（n=36），随访周期相对有限，且主要目的是评估可行性而非确切疗效，外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary pilot study with a small sample size (n=36), relatively limited follow-up, and its primary goal was to assess feasibility rather than definitive efficacy, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Muscle work during manual wheelchair propulsion in people with a spinal cord injury: a model-based approach.
items.summary: This study used a modeling approach to evaluate the individual muscle contributions, particularly the rotator cuff muscles, to mechanical work during wheelchair propulsion in individuals with a spinal cord injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项模型研究量化了脊髓损伤患者手动轮椅推进过程中，包括肩袖肌在内的个体肌肉贡献。这能帮你更精准地调整康复策略，预防肩部过度使用损伤。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者手动轮椅推进过程中的肌肉做功：一项基于模型的研究
items.summaryZh: 这项研究采用模型方法，评估了脊髓损伤患者手动轮椅推进过程中，特别是肩袖肌对机械做功的个体肌肉贡献。
items.curatedReasonEn: This model-based study quantifies individual muscle contributions, including rotator cuff muscles, during manual wheelchair propulsion in SCI patients. Use these insights to fine-tune rehabilitation strategies and prevent shoulder overuse injuries.
items.limitation: 本研究采用建模方法，其结果的临床转化需通过活体生物力学和临床结果进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This study employed a modeling approach; its clinical translation requires further validation through in-vivo biomechanics and clinical outcomes.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Physiotherapy Educational Intervention for Occipital Positional Plagiocephaly Prevention: a Multicentre Randomised Controlled Trial
items.summary: A multicentre randomized controlled trial found no statistically significant difference in positional occipital plagiocephaly prevalence at 3 months in infants whose mothers received prenatal physiotherapy educational intervention.
items.curatedReason: 针对胎儿期姿势性斜头畸形（POP）的孕期物理治疗教育干预，在本 RCT 中未能降低婴儿 3 个月时的 POP 发生率。这意味着单纯的产前教育对 POP 预防效果有限，需要重新思考干预策略。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗教育干预预防枕骨姿势性斜头畸形：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验显示，接受产前物理治疗教育干预的孕妇，其婴儿在 3 个月时姿势性枕骨斜头畸形（POP）的发生率与对照组无统计学显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Prenatal physiotherapy education interventions for positional occipital plagiocephaly (POP) did not reduce POP prevalence at 3 months in this RCT. This suggests that standalone prenatal education may have limited efficacy for POP prevention, prompting a re-evaluation of intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明干预教育的具体内容和强度，可能影响结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the specific content and intensity of the educational intervention, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: If ACL injury is multifactorial, why is return-to-sport testing not? A determinant-alignment framework for ACL rehabilitation and return to sport.
items.summary: This Masterclass proposes a determinant-alignment framework for late-stage rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessment after ACL reconstruction, advocating for a more comprehensive evaluation beyond physical capacity.
items.curatedReason: ACL 损伤后的重返运动（RTS）评估，不仅要看体能，更要重视感知、神经认知和运动情境。这个框架提醒你别只盯着跳跃和力量，要让 RTS 方案更全面。
items.titleZh: 既然 ACL 损伤是多因素的，为什么重返运动测试却不是？一个 ACL 康复和重返运动的决定因素对齐框架
items.summaryZh: 这篇大师班文章提出一个决定因素对齐框架，用于 ACL 重建后的后期康复和重返运动评估，强调超越单一的体能评估，整合多维度的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: ACL return-to-sport (RTS) assessment needs to move beyond just physical capacity to integrate perceptual, neurocognitive, and contextual demands. This framework encourages you to broaden your RTS protocols beyond hop and strength tests for a more comprehensive approach.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Implementing an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in oldest-old nursing home residents: protocol for a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial (SCOPE Study)
items.summary: This article describes the protocol for a pragmatic cluster-randomized controlled trial (SCOPE Study) aiming to implement an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents.
items.curatedReason: 这是一个研究方案，而非已完成的试验结果。它为你展示了针对最老年卧床患者肌少症运动干预的设计思路，但尚无实际数据供你参考临床效果。
items.titleZh: 针对最老年养老院居民肌少症运动干预的实施：一项实用型整群随机对照试验（SCOPE 研究）方案
items.summaryZh: 本文介绍了一项实用型整群随机对照试验（SCOPE 研究）的方案，旨在为最老年养老院居民实施一项肌少症运动干预。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a study protocol, not completed trial results. It showcases the design of an exercise intervention for sarcopenia in the oldest-old nursing home residents, but there is no actual data yet to inform clinical efficacy.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未提供实际研究结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol and does not provide actual research findings yet.

items.title: Sarcopenia, Nutritional Status, and the Association Between Rehabilitation Dose and Functional Efficiency After Inpatient Rehabilitation for First-Ever Ischemic Stroke.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study of 1,036 ischemic stroke patients found that a higher rehabilitation dose (per 30 min/day; β=0.17, 95% CI 0.12 to 0.21) was associated with greater functional efficiency, while sarcopenia was linked to lower efficiency.
items.curatedReason: 这项单中心回顾性队列研究提示，卒中患者的康复剂量与功能效率正相关，肌少症则与功能效率降低相关。这支持了在卒中康复中，应积极评估并管理患者的肌少症状态，可能需要更大康复剂量来优化结局。
items.titleZh: 首次缺血性卒中住院康复后肌少症、营养状况与康复剂量、功能效率之间的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对 1,036 名首次缺血性卒中患者的单中心回顾性队列研究显示，每增加 30 分钟/天的康复剂量与更高的功能效率相关（β=0.17），而肌少症与功能效率降低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-center retrospective cohort study suggests that rehabilitation dose is positively associated with functional efficiency after stroke, while sarcopenia is linked to reduced efficiency. This supports actively assessing and managing sarcopenia in stroke rehabilitation, potentially necessitating higher rehabilitation doses to optimize outcomes.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性观察研究，存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，且其结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective observational study, subject to selection bias and confounding factors, and its generalizability is limited.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of ankle-foot orthosis-related conditions on muscle activity, spasticity, and psychosocial outcomes after stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 studies (N=931 participants) evaluated the effects of ankle-foot orthoses (AFOs) after stroke, finding uncertain effects on lower-limb muscle activity, spasticity, and psychosocial outcomes, despite their common use for gait improvement.
items.curatedReason: 踝足矫形器（AFO）在卒中后改善踝关节稳定性和步态的传统认知不变。但在肌肉活动、痉挛和心理社会结局上，别过度解读其疗效，目前证据并不确凿。
items.titleZh: 踝足矫形器相关条件对卒中后肌肉活动、痉挛及心理社会结局影响的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 10 项研究（931 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析评估了卒中后踝足矫形器（AFOs）的效果，发现尽管 AFOs 普遍用于改善步态，但其对下肢肌肉活动、痉挛和心理社会结局的影响仍不确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: The traditional understanding that ankle-foot orthoses (AFOs) improve ankle stability and gait after stroke holds. However, don't overstate their effects on muscle activity, spasticity, and psychosocial outcomes; current evidence remains uncertain.
items.limitation: 纳入研究在 AFO-相关条件（如类型、穿戴时间、联合干预）上存在异质性，且部分结局指标（如心理社会结局）的研究数量和质量有限。
items.limitationEn: There was heterogeneity in AFO-related conditions (e.g., type, wearing time, combined interventions) across included studies, and limited quantity and quality of research for some outcomes (e.g., psychosocial outcomes).

items.title: Exploring the experience of time-restricted eating in veterans with spinal cord injury and obesity: a qualitative study.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored the experiences of 15 veterans with chronic spinal cord injury and obesity participating in a 10-hour time-restricted eating (TRE) trial, finding positive insights into its feasibility and potential benefits for weight management.
items.curatedReason: 针对脊髓损伤伴肥胖的退伍军人，限时进食（TRE）可能是一种可行的体重管理策略。尽管是定性研究，但它提示了潜在的依从性和益处，为未来的干预设计提供了用户视角。
items.titleZh: 探索脊髓损伤伴肥胖退伍军人限时进食体验的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了 15 名患有慢性脊髓损伤和肥胖的退伍军人参与 10 小时限时进食（TRE）试验的体验，为体重管理的可行性和潜在益处提供了积极见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Time-restricted eating (TRE) may be a viable weight management strategy for veterans with spinal cord injury and obesity. Although a qualitative study, it highlights potential adherence and benefits, offering a user perspective for future intervention design.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（N=15），主要探索参与者的体验，不提供量化疗效证据，且人群仅限于截瘫退伍军人。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (N=15), exploring participant experiences rather than providing quantitative efficacy. The population is limited to veterans with paraplegia.

items.title: A Valid and Reliable Virtual Reality Tool for Assessment of Arm Nonuse Post-Stroke
items.summary: A novel virtual reality-based arm nonuse (VR-NonUse) tool demonstrated reliability, validity, and usability for assessing arm nonuse post-stroke during naturalistic reaching under varying cognitive and motor demands.
items.curatedReason: 这款 VR 工具为卒中后手臂失用提供了标准化的评估方法，可能帮助你更客观地量化患者的表现，并指导康复干预。但记得，这是预印本研究，结论有待同行评审。
items.titleZh: 一项用于卒中后手臂失用评估的有效且可靠的虚拟现实工具
items.summaryZh: 一项新颖的基于虚拟现实的手臂失用（VR-NonUse）工具在评估卒中后手臂失用方面显示出可靠性、有效性和可用性，该工具在不同的认知和运动需求下测量自然伸手动作。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized assessment for post-stroke arm nonuse remains a clinical gap, and this VR tool offers a promising new avenue. It presents the potential to quantify a patient's natural arm use under varying cognitive and motor demands, which could aid in more objective tracking of rehabilitation progress down the line. Keep in mind, however, that this is currently a preprint and has not yet undergone rigorous peer review.
items.limitation: 这是一项预印本研究，尚未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This is a preprint study and has not yet undergone peer review.

items.title: Clinical sensory tests in professional practice: a web-based survey on awareness and challenges among Italian physicians and physiotherapists.
items.summary: A web-based survey revealed that Italian physicians and physiotherapists have limited awareness and face barriers in applying clinical sensory testing, despite its potential for somatosensory function appraisal.
items.curatedReason: 这项调查评估了意大利医生和物理治疗师对临床感觉测试的认知及其在实践中遇到的障碍。了解这些挑战有助于我们思考如何在不同地区推广和优化评估方法。
items.titleZh: 意大利医生和物理治疗师对临床感觉测试的认知与挑战：一项网络调查
items.titleEn: Clinical sensory tests in professional practice: a web-based survey on awareness and challenges among Italian physicians and physiotherapists.
items.summaryZh: 一项网络调查显示，尽管临床感觉测试有潜力评估躯体感觉功能，但意大利医生和物理治疗师对其认知有限，并在实践中面临障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey assesses Italian physicians' and physiotherapists' perceptions of clinical sensory testing and the challenges encountered in practice. Understanding these barriers can inform strategies for promoting and optimizing assessment methods across different regions.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于意大利的医生和物理治疗师，并且是基于自我报告的，可能存在报告偏差。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to physicians and physiotherapists in Italy and relies on self-reported data, which may introduce reporting bias.

items.title: Proprioception Training and Surrogate Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Definitions, Measures, and Effectiveness Claims
items.summary: A systematic review explored the definitions, measures, and effectiveness claims of proprioception training, revealing significant heterogeneity in its conceptualization and application across rehabilitation and sports practices.
items.curatedReason: 这篇系统综述揭示本体感觉训练在定义、测量和声称疗效上存在高度异质性。它提醒你应审慎看待这一概念，并确保干预措施有明确的理论基础和可量化的目标，而不是盲目沿用宽泛的“本体感觉训练”术语。
items.titleZh: 本体感觉训练与替代结局：定义、测量和有效性主张的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇系统综述探讨了本体感觉训练的定义、测量方法和疗效声称，揭示了其在康复和运动实践中概念化和应用上的显著异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights the high heterogeneity in definitions, measures, and claimed effectiveness of proprioception training. It cautions you to critically evaluate this concept and ensure interventions have a clear theoretical basis and quantifiable goals, rather than blindly using the broad term 'proprioception training'.
items.limitation: 综述发现现有研究在本体感觉训练的定义和测量上存在显著异质性，这可能影响其对干预效果的综合评估。
items.limitationEn: The review identified significant heterogeneity in the definitions and measures of proprioception training across studies, which may impact the comprehensive assessment of intervention effectiveness.

related.title: Proprioception Training and Surrogate Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Definitions, Measures, and Effectiveness Claims.

items.title: Trajectories of rehabilitation exercise adherence after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a prospective longitudinal study
items.summary: A prospective longitudinal study identified distinct trajectories of rehabilitation exercise adherence after hip fracture surgery in older adults, highlighting varying patterns of engagement over time.
items.curatedReason: 髋部骨折术后老年患者的康复依从性是影响预后的关键因素。本研究揭示了不同的依从性轨迹，有助于你根据患者情况进行风险分层，并制定个性化依从性干预策略。
items.titleZh: 老年髋部骨折术后康复锻炼依从性轨迹：一项前瞻性纵向研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性纵向研究揭示了老年髋部骨折术后康复锻炼依从性的不同轨迹，突出了随时间变化的参与模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rehabilitation adherence is crucial for older adults post-hip fracture surgery. This study reveals distinct adherence trajectories, helping you stratify patient risk and tailor adherence interventions for better outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究未明确是否控制了社会经济地位和认知功能等可能影响依从性的混杂因素，可能限制结果的解释。
items.limitationEn: The study does not explicitly state whether confounding factors such as socioeconomic status and cognitive function, which may influence adherence, were controlled, potentially limiting the interpretation of results.

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $5.48 Million to Strengthen Healthcare Workforce Pipeline in Rural Rhode Island
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $5.48 million federal investment to strengthen the healthcare workforce pipeline in rural Rhode Island through the Rural Health Transformation Program.
items.curatedReason: 美国联邦政府的这笔拨款旨在加强罗德岛农村地区的医疗劳动力队伍。这对于当地的物理治疗执业者而言，意味着未来潜在的就业机会增加、人才储备改善，以及医疗服务可及性的提升。
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款 548 万美元加强罗德岛农村地区医疗劳动力输送
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款 548 万美元，通过联邦农村卫生转型计划，加强罗德岛农村地区的医疗劳动力输送。
items.curatedReasonEn: This federal grant in the US aims to bolster the healthcare workforce in rural Rhode Island. For local physical therapists, this signals potential increases in job opportunities, an improved talent pool, and enhanced healthcare access.

items.title: Hand function, reaction speed, and competitive ranking in licensed and amateur male league of legends players: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated hand function, reaction speed, and competitive ranking in licensed and amateur male League of Legends players, revealing potential associations between these factors.
items.curatedReason: 虽然只是个案研究，但它提示我们电子竞技选手的确存在独特的生理和功能需求，值得物理治疗师关注。这意味着你需要将这类新兴运动群体纳入评估范围，为他们量身定制干预方案。
items.titleZh: 男性英雄联盟职业和业余玩家的手功能、反应速度和竞技排名：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究调查了男性英雄联盟职业和业余玩家的手功能、反应速度和竞技排名，揭示了这些因素之间潜在的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: While a cross-sectional study, it suggests esports athletes have unique physiological and functional demands that warrant our attention. This means you should include this emerging athletic population in your assessments and tailor interventions accordingly.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，不能建立因果关系，且仅限于男性英雄联盟玩家，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality and is limited to male League of Legends players, thus having limited generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Reframing patient expectations as therapeutic targets in musculoskeletal care.
items.summary: Patient expectations (PEs) are often underappreciated but profoundly impactful in musculoskeletal pain management. This professional practice article argues that PEs are modifiable therapeutic targets, extending beyond treatment and recovery to encompass relational, contextual, lifestyle, spiritual, and cultural dimensions.
items.curatedReason: 患者预期（PEs）在肌肉骨骼疼痛管理中不只是预后因素，更是可被干预的治疗靶点。重新审视 PEs 的多维度作用，能助你更有效地管理患者。
items.titleZh: 将患者预期重塑为肌肉骨骼护理中的治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 患者预期（PEs）在肌肉骨骼疼痛管理中常被低估，但影响深远。这篇专业实践文章指出，PEs 不仅是预后因素，更是可被干预的治疗靶点，其影响范围超越治疗和康复，延伸至关系、情境、生活方式、精神和文化层面。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patient expectations (PEs) in musculoskeletal pain management are not merely prognostic but modifiable therapeutic targets. Reconsidering the multidimensional role of PEs can help you manage patients more effectively.
items.limitation: 这是一篇专业实践文章，非原创研究，主要基于专家意见和现有文献综述。
items.limitationEn: This is a professional practice article, not original research, primarily based on expert opinion and existing literature review.

items.title: Impact of Social Determinants of Health on Physical Therapy Utilization in Home Health and Outpatient Settings: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of Medicare fee-for-service claims identified patient-, hospital-, and regional-level social determinants of health (SDOH) factors associated with home health and outpatient physical therapy utilization after lower extremity joint replacement.
items.curatedReason: 理解社会决定因素 (SDOH) 如何影响下肢关节置换术后物理治疗利用率，对于优化转诊和干预、减少服务不足风险至关重要。这有助于你在制定治疗计划时考量患者的社会经济背景。
items.titleZh: 社会决定因素对居家和门诊物理治疗利用率的影响：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项对 Medicare 按服务收费索赔的横断面研究，识别了患者、医院和区域层面的社会决定因素 (SDOH) 中与下肢关节置换术后居家和门诊物理治疗利用率相关的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding how social determinants of health (SDOH) impact physical therapy utilization after lower extremity joint replacement is crucial for optimizing referrals and interventions, reducing the risk of underserved populations. This helps you consider patients' socioeconomic backgrounds when developing treatment plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性横断面研究，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cross-sectional study cannot establish causality.

items.title: Clinicians’ ethical considerations regarding the use of prediction models in hand and wrist care: a qualitative study.
items.summary: This qualitative study explores clinicians' ethical considerations regarding the use of prediction models, created by machine learning, in hand and wrist care, particularly concerning shared decision-making.
items.curatedReason: AI 预测模型在手腕部护理中的伦理问题需要我们审慎对待。此研究提示，我们在将这些模型纳入共享决策时，务必关注其对患者自主性的潜在影响，切勿盲目推崇。
items.titleZh: 临床医生对手腕部护理中预测模型伦理考量的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了临床医生在手腕部护理中，对手工学习创建的预测模型使用的伦理考量，特别是关于共享决策的方面。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ethical implications of AI predictive models in hand and wrist care warrant careful consideration. This study suggests that while integrating these models into shared decision-making, we must remain vigilant about their potential impact on patient autonomy, rather than adopting them uncritically.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果可能不具普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size, and its findings may not be generalizable.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Biological effects of technique-specific manual therapy in healthy individuals and people with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: This systematic review with meta-analysis evaluates the neurophysiological and metabolic effects of technique-specific manual therapy (HVLA vs. non-HVLA) in healthy individuals and people with musculoskeletal disorders, registered prospectively in PROSPERO.
items.curatedReason: 手法治疗（MT）在肌骨疾病中的生物学效应一直缺乏清晰的综合证据，尤其是区分不同手法技术和解剖区域。这项高质量系统综述和荟萃分析将揭示不同 MT 技术（HVLA vs. 非 HVLA）的神经生理和代谢机制，这对于你理解和选择特定手法干预，提升循证实践至关重要。
items.titleZh: 特定手法治疗对健康个体及肌肉骨骼疾病患者的生物学效应：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了特定手法治疗（高速度低幅度[HVLA]与非HVLA）对健康个体和肌骨疾病患者的神经生理和代谢效应，并探讨了不同手法特点和解剖区域的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: The biological effects of manual therapy (MT) in musculoskeletal disorders have lacked clear, synthesized evidence, especially when distinguishing between techniques and anatomical regions. This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis will elucidate the neurophysiological and metabolic mechanisms of different MT techniques (HVLA vs. non-HVLA), which is crucial for you to understand and select specific manual interventions, enhancing evidence-based practice.
items.limitation: 本系统综述的结论可能受限于纳入研究的异质性以及对某些具体手法或生理机制的详细报告不足。
items.limitationEn: The conclusions of this systematic review might be limited by the heterogeneity of included studies and insufficient detailed reporting on certain specific manual techniques or physiological mechanisms.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Developing biopsychosocial competence in musculoskeletal pain care: Australian physiotherapy educators' perspectives.
items.summary: This qualitative study explores the perspectives of 18 Australian physiotherapy educators on translating the biopsychosocial approach to pain care from knowing to doing, identifying challenges in practical clinical adoption.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚的物理治疗教育者认为，整合生物心理社会模型到疼痛护理教学中存在挑战，主要障碍在于教学方法和临床实践中的具体应用。这提示了在教育端需更注重"如何做"的实践性指导，而不仅是理论灌输。
items.titleZh: 在肌肉骨骼疼痛护理中培养生物心理社会能力：澳大利亚物理治疗教育者的视角
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了18位澳大利亚物理治疗教育者对将生物心理社会方法从认知层面（“是什么”）转化为实践层面（临床应用中的“如何做”）的看法，揭示了在临床采纳中面临的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: Australian physiotherapy educators face challenges in integrating the biopsychosocial model into pain care education, primarily in teaching methods and practical clinical application. This suggests a need for more practical "how-to" guidance in education, beyond theoretical knowledge.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索，样本量较小（18位教育者），其发现的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study with a small sample size (18 educators) may have limited generalizability of its findings.

items.title: The Impact of Upper Extremity Rehabilitation on Fatigue in Individuals With Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: This systematic review evaluates and synthesizes existing evidence on the effects of upper extremity rehabilitation interventions on fatigue in individuals with multiple sclerosis, following PRISMA guidelines and PROSPERO registration.
items.curatedReason: 尽管多发性硬化症患者的疲劳感是常见问题，但上肢康复对其影响的证据尚不明确。这项系统综述将帮助我们理解上肢康复干预在减轻疲劳方面的潜力，未来可用于指导多发性硬化症患者的康复计划。
items.titleZh: 上肢康复对多发性硬化症患者疲劳影响的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 本系统综述旨在评估和综合现有证据，探讨上肢康复干预对多发性硬化症（PwMS）患者疲劳的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Although fatigue is a common issue in individuals with multiple sclerosis, the evidence on upper extremity rehabilitation's impact remains limited. This systematic review will help us understand the potential of upper extremity rehabilitation interventions in alleviating fatigue, guiding future rehabilitation plans for MS patients.
items.limitation: 系统综述的结果质量取决于其纳入研究的质量，若原始研究设计和方法学存在异质性或局限，综述结论可能受影响。
items.limitationEn: The quality of systematic review results depends on the quality of its included studies; heterogeneity or limitations in original study designs and methodologies may affect the review's conclusions.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: The Effect of Robot-Assisted Gait Training on Balance, Gait and Kinesiophobia in Individuals With Post-Stroke Hemiparesis: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This single-blind, parallel-group randomized controlled trial with 60 participants explored the effects of adding robot-assisted gait training to conventional rehabilitation on balance, gait, and kinesiophobia in individuals with post-stroke hemiparesis.
items.curatedReason: 机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）对卒中后步态康复的有效性已得到证实，但其对患者运动恐惧症等心理行为结局的影响尚不明确。这项随机对照试验提示 RAGT 不仅能改善步态和平衡，还能缓解患者对运动的恐惧，为卒中康复提供了更全面的视角。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练对卒中偏瘫患者平衡、步态和运动恐惧症的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项单盲、平行组随机对照试验纳入60名卒中偏瘫患者，评估了机器人辅助步态训练联合常规康复对患者平衡、步态和运动恐惧症的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) is effective for post-stroke gait rehabilitation, but its impact on psychological and behavioral outcomes like kinesiophobia has been less clear. This RCT suggests RAGT not only improves gait and balance but also alleviates fear of movement, offering a more holistic perspective on stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，且样本量为60人，可能存在偏倚或统计效能不足的风险。
items.limitationEn: This study is single-blind and involves 60 participants, which may pose risks of bias or insufficient statistical power.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Comparison of action observation therapy and virtual reality combined with conventional therapy for upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy.
items.summary: This study randomized 45 children (aged 5-15 years) with unilateral cerebral palsy into three groups (AOT, XBOX Kinect, Conventional) to compare the effects of action observation therapy and virtual reality combined with conventional therapy on upper extremity function.
items.curatedReason: 对于单侧脑瘫儿童的上肢康复，行动观察疗法（AOT）和虚拟现实（VR）结合传统疗法，相较于单独传统疗法能带来额外获益。这意味着未来可以通过技术辅助干预，提升这些儿童的上肢功能和日常参与度。
items.titleZh: 行动观察疗法与虚拟现实结合常规疗法对单侧脑瘫儿童上肢康复效果的比较
items.summaryZh: 这项研究比较了行动观察疗法（AOT）和XBOX 360 Kinect™（XBOX）结合常规疗法，对45名单侧脑瘫儿童上肢结构功能、活动和功能参与水平的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: For upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy, action observation therapy (AOT) and virtual reality (VR) combined with conventional therapy offer additional benefits compared to conventional therapy alone. This implies that technology-assisted interventions can enhance upper limb function and daily participation in these children.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间较短（3周），长期效果及不同干预措施间的具体优势需要更多研究确认。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period of this study is short (3 weeks), and long-term effects and specific advantages between different interventions require further research.

items.title: Effects of a Cycling-Based Aerobic Exercise Program Versus a Resistance and Neuromuscular Exercise Program on Exercise-Induced Hypoalgesia in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Study Protocol for a Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This randomized clinical trial protocol outlines a study comparing a cycling-based aerobic exercise program versus a resistance and neuromuscular exercise program on exercise-induced hypoalgesia in 90 participants with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 对膝骨关节炎患者来说，明确不同运动模式在运动诱导镇痛（EIH）上的具体机制差异，能帮我们更精准地开具运动处方。这个 RCT 方案旨在比较循环有氧与抗阻及神经肌肉训练对 90 名患者 EIH 的影响，值得期待最终结果。
items.titleZh: 循环有氧运动与抗阻及神经肌肉运动方案对膝骨关节炎运动诱导镇痛影响的随机临床试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这项随机临床试验方案旨在比较循环有氧运动与抗阻及神经肌肉运动方案对90名膝骨关节炎患者运动诱导镇痛（EIH）效果的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: For knee OA patients, understanding how different exercise modalities impact exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH) mechanistically will allow for more precise exercise prescriptions. This RCT protocol, comparing cycling-based aerobic vs. resistance and neuromuscular training in 90 participants, is one to watch for its final outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究仅为方案，尚未发布结果，其有效性和临床影响尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and results are not yet available, so its effectiveness and clinical impact remain to be determined.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: [Comment] Robotics in total knee replacement
items.summary: This commentary explores whether improved outcomes in total knee replacement (TKR) can be solely attributed to robotic-assisted techniques, suggesting that alignment strategies and patient expectations significantly complicate the equation.
items.curatedReason: 机器人辅助全膝关节置换术的评论文章。目前尚不明确机器人辅助技术是否能独立带来更好的结果，它受手术策略和患者个体差异影响。
items.titleZh: 评论：机器人辅助全膝关节置换术
items.summaryZh: 全膝关节置换术（TKR）的改善效果不能完全归因于选择机器人辅助或传统手术技术，因为TKR的对线策略（机械、功能、运动学和解剖学）以及患者期望的异质性使问题复杂化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary discusses robotic-assisted total knee replacement. It remains unclear whether robotic assistance alone leads to superior outcomes, as it is influenced by surgical strategy and patient heterogeneity.

items.title: Liposuction versus conservative therapy for patients with lipoedema in Germany: a multicentre, randomised controlled clinical trial
items.summary: A multicenter, randomized controlled clinical trial in Germany found liposuction to be superior to conservative therapy in reducing leg pain and improving quality of life for patients with lipoedema, despite being associated with a higher rate of serious adverse events.
items.curatedReason: 对脂肪水肿患者，抽脂术在减轻腿部疼痛和改善生活质量方面优于保守治疗，但需注意其潜在的严重不良事件风险。在临床实践中，为患者提供此治疗方案时应权衡利弊。
items.titleZh: 德国一项多中心随机对照临床试验：抽脂术对比保守疗法治疗脂肪水肿患者
items.summaryZh: 一项德国多中心随机对照临床试验显示，抽脂术在减轻脂肪水肿患者的腿部疼痛和改善生活质量方面优于保守治疗，但其严重不良事件发生率也更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with lipoedema, liposuction is superior to conservative therapy in reducing leg pain and improving quality of life, but carries a higher risk of serious adverse events. Clinicians should weigh these benefits against the risks when offering this treatment option.
items.limitation: 该研究关注的主要是短期效果和自我报告的疼痛/生活质量指标，长期效果和更客观的肢体功能改善仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily focused on short-term outcomes and self-reported pain/quality of life, with long-term effects and objective limb function improvements requiring further investigation.

items.title: Gait Speed Changes in Stroke Rehabilitation Motor Lower Extremity Randomized Controlled Trials by Intervention and Time Post-Stroke: A Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A meta-analysis examined gait speed changes in randomized controlled trials of motor lower extremity stroke rehabilitation across various interventions, compared to conventional care or sham controls, at different time points post-stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这份高质量的系统综述明确了卒中后下肢康复中，哪些干预措施能在不同时间点改善步速，以及改善程度。制定治疗方案时，你应该优先选择那些在患者当前阶段有明确循证支持且效果量可观的干预，而非寄希望于“常规护理”能带来显著步速提升。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复下肢运动随机对照试验中步速变化：按干预措施和卒中后时间分类的荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃分析评估了在卒中后下肢运动康复的随机对照试验中，不同干预措施与常规护理或假对照相比，在不同时间点对步速改变的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review clarifies which lower extremity rehabilitation interventions improve gait speed at different post-stroke time points, and by how much. When designing treatment plans, you should prioritize interventions with clear evidence and substantial effect sizes for the patient's current stage, rather than hoping 'conventional care' alone will significantly improve gait speed.
items.limitation: 不同研究之间可能存在干预方案、评估工具和患者特征的异质性，可能影响结果的总体解释。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in intervention protocols, assessment tools, and patient characteristics across studies might affect the overall interpretation of results.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

related.title: Gait Speed Changes in Stroke Rehabilitation Motor Lower Extremity Randomized Controlled Trials by Intervention and Time Post-Stroke: A Meta-Analysis.

items.title: Manual Lymph Drainage in Lower Extremity Lymphedema Management: An Essential Component or An Optional Extra? A Single-Blind, Randomized Non-Inferiority Trial
items.summary: A single-blind, randomized non-inferiority trial investigated whether compression bandaging alone is non-inferior to combined manual lymphatic drainage in reducing limb volume, tissue stiffness, and skin/subcutaneous thickness in stage 2–3 lower extremity lymphedema during the intensive phase of treatment.
items.curatedReason: 这项非劣效性试验提示，在下肢淋巴水肿的强化治疗阶段，单纯加压包扎在减少肢体容积和改善组织硬度方面，可能不劣于联合手工淋巴引流。这意味着你可能需要重新评估是否所有患者都需要常规进行手工淋巴引流。
items.titleZh: 下肢淋巴水肿管理中的手工淋巴引流：必要组成部分还是可选附加项？一项单盲随机非劣效性试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机非劣效性试验旨在确定在 2-3 期下肢淋巴水肿强化治疗阶段，单纯加压包扎在减少肢体容积、组织硬度和皮肤/皮下厚度方面，是否不劣于联合手工淋巴引流。
items.curatedReasonEn: This non-inferiority trial suggests that, during the intensive phase of lower extremity lymphedema treatment, compression bandaging alone may be non-inferior to combined manual lymphatic drainage for reducing limb volume and improving tissue stiffness. You may need to re-evaluate whether all patients routinely require manual lymphatic drainage.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注了强化治疗阶段的短期效果，长期维持阶段的干预效果和患者依从性未被评估。
items.limitationEn: The study only focused on short-term outcomes during the intensive treatment phase; long-term effects in the maintenance phase and patient adherence were not assessed.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: More Than Just Arm Movement: Finger-Worn Accelerometers Provide a Valid and Sensitive Alternative to Wrist-Worn Accelerometers for Measuring Real-World Upper-Limb Performance in Stroke Survivors
items.summary: A study investigated the clinical validity of finger-worn accelerometers as a comprehensive and sensitive alternative to wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb motor performance in stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，指戴式加速度计在测量卒中幸存者上肢真实世界表现方面，是腕戴式加速度计的有效且敏感替代方案。如果你正在寻找更精确或更少干扰的穿戴式设备来评估患者的上肢功能，指戴式设备值得你考虑。
items.titleZh: 不只是手臂运动：指戴式加速度计为卒中幸存者上肢真实世界表现测量提供了一种有效且敏感的替代方案
items.summaryZh: 一项研究探讨了指戴式加速度计在测量卒中幸存者真实世界上肢运动表现方面的临床有效性，发现它作为腕戴式加速度计的替代方案，既全面又敏感。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that finger-worn accelerometers are a valid and sensitive alternative to wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb performance in stroke survivors. If you are seeking a more precise or less intrusive wearable device to assess patients' upper-limb function, finger-worn devices are worth considering.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是设备的临床验证性，但未直接评估不同设备在指导康复干预或改善患者结局方面的差异。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on the clinical validity of the devices but did not directly assess differences in guiding rehabilitation interventions or improving patient outcomes between them.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Feasibility and Safety Evaluation of Hybrid Assistive Limb-Based Neurorehabilitation for Patients with Central Motor Dysfunction: A Single-Center Study
items.summary: A single-center study evaluated the feasibility and safety of Hybrid Assistive Limb-based neurorehabilitation for patients with central motor dysfunction, including stroke, traumatic brain, and spinal-cord injuries, aiming to enhance daily living independence.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了混合辅助肢体 (Hybrid Assistive Limb, HAL) 在中枢运动功能障碍患者神经康复中可行性和安全性的初步证据。如果你的诊所正在考虑引入此类高科技辅助设备，这项研究可以作为你评估其潜力的一个起点，但请注意其单中心和初步的性质。
items.titleZh: 混合辅助肢体神经康复对中枢运动功能障碍患者的可行性与安全性评估：一项单中心研究
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心研究评估了基于混合辅助肢体 (HAL) 的神经康复在中枢运动功能障碍（包括卒中、创伤性脑和脊髓损伤）患者中的可行性和安全性，旨在提高日常生活自理能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers preliminary evidence on the feasibility and safety of Hybrid Assistive Limb (HAL) neurorehabilitation for patients with central motor dysfunction. If your clinic is considering integrating such high-tech assistive devices, this study can serve as a starting point for evaluating its potential, while noting its single-center and preliminary nature.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，样本量较小，且缺乏对照组，无法确证 HAL 的实际疗效和与其他干预的比较优势。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center study with a small sample size and lacks a control group, preventing conclusive determination of HAL's efficacy and comparative advantages over other interventions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

related.title: Feasibility and Safety Evaluation of Hybrid Assistive Limb-Based Neurorehabilitation for Patients with Central Motor Dysfunction: A Single-Center Study.

items.title: Navigating expectation-evidence tensions in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: This professional practice article discusses the contextual and ethical foundations of patient expectations in musculoskeletal physiotherapy and introduces the Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment framework to address the tension between patient expectations and evidence-informed care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇专业实践文章提出了一个框架，帮助您在骨科物理治疗中平衡患者期望与循证实践。它承认患者期望对治疗效果的影响，并提供了一个结构化方法来处理由此产生的伦理和临床挑战，促进以人为本的护理，同时维护专业完整性。
items.titleZh: 应对肌肉骨骼物理治疗中期望与证据之间的张力
items.summaryZh: 这篇专业实践文章讨论了肌肉骨骼物理治疗中患者期望的背景和伦理基础，并引入了“情境知情期望对齐框架”，以解决患者期望与循证护理之间的张力。
items.curatedReasonEn: You now have a “Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment” framework to navigate the tension between patient expectations and evidence-informed practice. Patient expectations demonstrably impact outcomes; your role is to manage these effectively while upholding professional ethics and evidence-based principles, and this article offers a method to do so.

items.title: Reduced trailing limb angle is associated with near-falls during walking in stroke survivors.
items.summary: A cross-sectional observational study of 157 subacute stroke survivors found that a reduced trailing limb angle (TLA) during normal walking was associated with near-falls, highlighting a potential gait characteristic for fall risk assessment.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，卒中幸存者在步行时，较小的后肢摆动角（TLA）可能与近乎跌倒事件相关。这为您在进行步态评估和跌倒风险筛查时，提供了一个新的潜在生物力学指标。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者步行时后肢摆动角减小与近乎跌倒相关
items.summaryZh: 一项对 157 名亚急性卒中幸存者的横断面观察研究发现，正常步行时后肢摆动角（TLA）减小与近乎跌倒相关，提示其可能是跌倒风险评估的潜在步态特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that a reduced trailing limb angle (TLA) during walking may be associated with near-fall events in stroke survivors. This offers a new potential biomechanical indicator for your gait assessment and fall risk screening in this population.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察性设计，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study used a cross-sectional observational design, which cannot establish causality.

items.title: Physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in the emergency department (RESHAP-ED): a randomised controlled trial with economic evaluation.
items.summary: The RESHAP-ED randomized controlled trial found that physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in the emergency department significantly reduced length of stay and healthcare costs while maintaining non-inferior safety compared to usual care.
items.curatedReason: 由物理治疗师主导的急诊科肌肉骨骼疾病诊疗模式，在大样本随机对照试验中被证实能缩短急诊停留时间、降低医疗成本，且安全性不劣于常规护理。这是支持 PT 在急诊分流和管理中发挥更大作用的有力证据，是实践改变级别的信号。
items.titleZh: 急诊科肌肉骨骼疾病的物理治疗师主导护理（RESHAP-ED）：一项随机对照试验及经济学评价
items.summaryZh: RESHAP-ED 随机对照试验发现，与常规护理相比，物理治疗师主导的急诊科肌肉骨骼疾病诊疗显著缩短了患者的急诊停留时间，降低了医疗成本，且安全性不劣。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physiotherapist-led care for musculoskeletal conditions in the ED has been proven in a large RCT to reduce ED length of stay and costs, with non-inferior safety. This is strong, practice-changing evidence supporting an expanded role for PTs in ED triage and management.
items.limitation: 该研究排除了需要骨科会诊的复杂骨折和脱位，结果主要适用于非复杂型肌肉骨骼疾病。
items.limitationEn: The study excluded complex fractures and dislocations requiring orthopedic review, so results primarily apply to uncomplicated musculoskeletal conditions.

items.title: Methods for assessing core muscle co-activation in the lumbar region: a narrative review.
items.summary: This narrative review critically appraises current methods for assessing lumbar core muscle co-activation, categorizing them into surface electromyography and co-contraction index calculation, focusing on their theoretical basis, technical characteristics, and practical applicability.
items.curatedReason: 评估腰部核心肌肉协同激活的方法不少，但这篇综述提示，你需要警惕当前评估手段的局限性，尤其是表面肌电图和协同收缩指数的实际应用性。在临床中选择工具时，应根据具体目的和设备条件权衡其理论基础与技术特性。
items.titleZh: 腰部核心肌肉协同激活评估方法述评
items.summaryZh: 该述评批判性地评估了目前用于腰部核心肌肉协同激活的评估方法，主要分为表面肌电图和协同收缩指数计算，重点探讨了它们的理论基础、技术特点和临床适用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Methods for assessing lumbar core muscle co-activation are numerous, but this review highlights the limitations of current assessment tools, particularly the practical applicability of surface electromyography and co-contraction indices. When selecting tools in clinical practice, weigh their theoretical basis and technical characteristics against your specific objectives and available equipment.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Paired comparison of extrinsic feedback effects on motor learning and functional recovery after stroke: a secondary analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of randomized controlled trials (updated through November 2025) compared the effects of extrinsic feedback on motor learning versus functional recovery after stroke, calculating standardized mean differences using random-effects meta-analysis and accounting for within-study dependence.
items.curatedReason: 这项更新的荟萃分析提示，卒中后的外部反馈对运动学习和功能恢复效果不一。临床应用时，要根据具体的康复目标来调整反馈策略，而不是一概而论。
items.titleZh: 卒中后外部反馈对运动学习与功能恢复效果的配对比较：随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项基于随机对照试验的二次分析（更新至2025年11月）比较了卒中后外部反馈对运动学习与功能恢复的不同效果，使用随机效应荟萃分析计算标准化均差并考虑了研究内依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated meta-analysis suggests that extrinsic feedback after stroke has varied effects on motor learning and functional recovery. In clinical practice, adjust feedback strategies according to specific rehabilitation goals, rather than applying them uniformly.
items.limitation: 研究是基于已有随机对照试验的二次分析，可能受限于原始研究的设计和数据报告质量，且不同效应之间的相关性假设可能影响结果。
items.limitationEn: The study is a secondary analysis of existing randomized controlled trials, potentially limited by the design and data reporting quality of the original studies, and assumed correlations between different effects might influence the results.

items.title: Effects of short-term compression in people with knee osteoarthritis: A sham-controlled randomised trial.
items.summary: A three-arm randomized controlled trial (n=90) found that short-term knee compression with elastic bandages did not significantly improve pain intensity or physical function in individuals with knee osteoarthritis compared to sham or no bandaging at 6 days, 12, or 24 weeks post-intervention.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现，对膝骨关节炎患者短时应用弹力绷带，并不能在短期内显著缓解疼痛或改善功能。别指望它能替代主动治疗手段。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者短期加压治疗效果：一项假对照随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（n=90）发现，对膝骨关节炎患者短期使用弹力绷带进行膝关节加压，在干预后6天、12周和24周，与假对照组或无绷带组相比，并未显著改善疼痛强度或身体功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that short-term elastic bandaging for knee osteoarthritis patients did not significantly alleviate pain or improve function in the short term. Don't expect it to replace active treatment modalities.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了短期（12-24周）效果，对长期益处或不同压缩强度下的效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study only evaluated short-term (12-24 weeks) effects, and long-term benefits or effects under different compression intensities remain unclear.

items.title: Effects of ketogenic diet on obesity indices, lipid profile, and glycemic control parameters in athletes: a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials evaluated the effects of ketogenic diet on obesity indices, lipid profile, and glycemic control parameters in athletes, addressing inconsistencies in previous findings.
items.curatedReason: 对于运动员，生酮饮食对体重指标、血脂和血糖控制参数的效果仍需谨慎看待。在推荐前，务必权衡其潜在益处与代谢风险。
items.titleZh: 生酮饮食对运动员肥胖指标、血脂和血糖控制参数的影响：一项GRADE评估的随机对照试验系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项经过GRADE评估的随机对照试验系统综述和荟萃分析，评估了生酮饮食对运动员肥胖指标、血脂和血糖控制参数的影响，旨在解决此前研究结果的不一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: For athletes, the effects of ketogenic diet on obesity indices, lipid profile, and glycemic control parameters still require careful consideration. Before recommendation, it is essential to weigh its potential benefits against metabolic risks.
items.limitation: 系统综述可能存在纳入研究异质性高、样本量相对较小、随访时间不一等局限性，影响结论的普适性。
items.limitationEn: Systematic reviews may have limitations such as high heterogeneity among included studies, relatively small sample sizes, and varying follow-up durations, which can affect the generalizability of the conclusions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Selective differences in eccentric inter-limb mechanics during single-leg vertical jump six months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.summary: A prospective observational study found significant inter-limb eccentric mechanical differences in single-leg countermovement jump performance six months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) in 22 male patients compared to 22 matched controls.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后 6 个月，患者在单腿跳跃离心阶段仍存在患健侧肢体间力学差异。这提示我们不能仅凭功能测试过关就认为患者已完全康复，应关注离心力量与跳跃表现的精细不对称。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后 6 个月单腿垂直跳跃离心阶段患健侧肢体力学差异
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究发现，22 例男性前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）患者在术后 6 个月与 22 例匹配对照组相比，单腿反向运动跳跃的离心力学表现存在显著的患健侧差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Six months post-ACLR, patients still exhibit inter-limb eccentric mechanical asymmetries during single-leg jumps. This highlights that passing functional tests alone isn't sufficient for full recovery; precise eccentric strength and jump performance imbalances warrant attention.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性观察性研究，样本量有限（22 例 ACLR），且仅关注男性受试者，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This prospective observational study has a limited sample size (22 ACLR cases) and only focused on male participants, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Clinical Decision Making in Pediatric Physiotherapy: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified frameworks and factors influencing clinical decision-making (CDM) in pediatric physiotherapy, highlighting the complexities introduced by developmental variability, family-centered care, and age-appropriate child participation based on 22 included studies.
items.curatedReason: 儿科物理治疗的临床决策远比成人复杂。这份范围综述从 22 项研究中提炼出关键框架和影响因素，尤其是发展差异、家庭中心照护和儿童参与，提醒我们在实践中务必全面考量这些特有挑战。
items.titleZh: 儿科物理治疗临床决策：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述梳理了儿科物理治疗中临床决策（CDM）所使用的框架和影响因素，强调了发展差异、以家庭为中心的护理以及适龄儿童参与带来的复杂性，共纳入 22 项研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric PT clinical decision-making is inherently more complex than adult care. This scoping review, synthesizing 22 studies, identifies key frameworks and influencing factors, particularly developmental variability, family-centered care, and child participation. It's a solid reminder to comprehensively address these unique challenges in your practice.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，本研究旨在映射文献而非进行全面证据合成，因此未对证据质量进行严格评估。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, this study aimed to map the literature rather than perform a comprehensive evidence synthesis, thus not strictly evaluating evidence quality.
